# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old at the end of Volume 2  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c3 P16](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c30 P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and student  <sub>[v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Anne of Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c8 P56](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0056)</sub>; Cordelia  <sub>[v1 c3 P15](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl with large, expressive eyes that vary between gray and green. She has a small, pale, freckled face with a pronounced pointed chin and a sweet, expressive mouth. Her thick hair, originally a bright red that she deeply disliked, gradually darkens to a handsome auburn as she grows older.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)_

## Personality

Anne is intensely imaginative, romantic, and passionate, experiencing life's joys and sorrows with extreme vividness. She possesses a lively wit, a deep appreciation for nature and beauty, and an eager desire to win the affection of those around her. Though prone to impulsive mistakes and occasional dramatic outbursts of temper, she is fiercely loyal, generous, and quick to repent. As she matures, she develops greater self-control, quiet reflection, and a strong sense of duty without losing her innate capacity for joy and wonder.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c31 P20](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0020), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023), [v1 c38 P8](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0008)_

## Goals

- To achieve academic success and earn a college degree  <sub>[v1 c34 P25](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0025), [v1 c34 P27](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0027), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>
- To bring beauty, joy, and inspiration into the lives of others  <sub>[v2 c7 P15](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0015)</sub>

## History

Anne Shirley arrives in Avonlea on Prince Edward Island after being mistakenly brought from an orphan asylum by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert, who had intended to adopt a boy. Despite initial intentions to send her back, Marilla and Matthew decide to keep her at Green Gables. Anne quickly makes a bosom friend in Diana Barry and enters Avonlea school, where an incident involving Gilbert Blythe calling her 'Carrots' starts a long-standing academic rivalry and grudge. Over the next few years, Anne gets into various humorous mishaps, such as inadvertently getting Diana intoxicated on currant wine, accidentally dyeing her hair green, and falling off a roof on a dare. Her resourcefulness shines when she saves Diana's little sister Minnie May from croup. She joins the Queen's Academy class, earns her teacher's license in one year, and wins the prestigious Avery Scholarship. However, after Matthew suddenly dies of a heart attack and Marilla faces failing eyesight, Anne selflessly gives up her college scholarship to stay at Green Gables, taking the Avonlea schoolteaching position instead. She helps found the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, helps raise the Keith twins, and finally reconciles her long-standing feud with Gilbert Blythe, becoming close friends as they both prepare for their futures.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c16 P48](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0048), [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v1 c38 P54](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0054), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to schoolteachers Walter and Bertha Shirley, who both died of fever when she was three months old  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, helping care for four children  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived with Mrs. Hammond for over two years, looking after eight children, including three pairs of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Spent four months in the Hopeton orphan asylum before being brought to Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
